fallback_used: Executable planner-module checks via inline Node/TypeScript runtime
Source inspection of build/app/page.tsx and build/app/page.module.css
validation_method.notes: Playwright MCP was not available in this Codex session. I also attempted local Chrome and Edge headless launches, but both failed with sandbox access denied errors before interactive browser automation could start.

checks.name: Target URL responds with the sprint app
checks.evidence: HTTP GET to http://localhost:3000 returned 200. The rendered HTML title is Travel Candidate Organizer and the landing page includes the product name, value proposition, form labels, and a disabled generate button before required inputs are filled.

checks.name: Invalid timing guidance exists
checks.evidence: Executable planner-module check returned a non-empty inline validation message when the end date was earlier than the start date.

checks.name: Valid conditions generate a readable candidate set
checks.evidence: Executable planner-module check for departure Tokyo, 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-13, traveler couple, budget comfort, scope either, themes food plus culture returned 6 candidates. Each candidate included destination name, scope, budget range values, recommended stay, travel time label, score, and at least two reasons.

checks.name: Sorting logic changes ordering
checks.evidence: For the same valid result set, budget sort and travel-time sort both produced a different order from match-score order.

checks.name: No-match guidance path exists
checks.evidence: Executable planner-module check for a valid restrictive input returned 0 candidates and 3 recovery suggestions.

checks.name: Placeholder or TODO scaffolding in generated app code
checks.evidence: No TODO, todo, Coming soon, or stub markers were found in build/app, build/lib, or build/README.md.

checks.name: Statuses, notes, comparison, regenerate, and reset are wired in the app source
checks.evidence: Source inspection found state handlers and controls for status changes, notes, comparison selection, loading state, regenerate, and reset, but interactive browser execution could not be completed in this sandbox.

checks.name: Responsive behavior at about 390px and 1280px
checks.evidence: The CSS includes responsive single-column breakpoints and grid changes, but actual overflow and layout behavior were not browser-verified.

checks.name: Filter support referenced by the acceptance criteria
checks.evidence: No visible filter control or filter logic was found in the generated app. The implementation exposes sorting, but not filtering.

bugs.summary: Missing candidate filtering support referenced by acceptance criteria.
bugs.impact: The criterion about note persistence after filtering cannot be satisfied because the sprint app implements sorting only.
bugs.evidence: No filter control or filter state was found in build/app/page.tsx or build/lib/travel-planner.ts.

next_actions: Add a visible candidate filtering control or update the sprint-1 acceptance criteria to remove filtering from scope.
Re-run sprint 1 with working browser automation, ideally Playwright MCP, against http://localhost:3000.

During that browser run, explicitly verify same-page generation, loading visibility, shortlist summary live updates, note persistence after sorting and comparison, 2-3 card comparison rendering, regenerate, reset, and no horizontal overflow at about 390px and 1280px.
limitations: Interactive browser-only acceptance criteria were not exercised end-to-end because Playwright MCP was unavailable and fallback Chrome and Edge headless launches were blocked by sandbox access denied errors.
status_reason: Sprint 1 is not accepted yet because the written acceptance criteria mention filtering, but no filtering control is implemented, and several browser-only acceptance criteria remain unverified in this sandbox.
